description: We are a team of two enthusiastic learners passionate about space, science, and technology. Our strengths include creativity, research, problem-solving, storytelling, and learning new technologies. Inspired by the challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten," we aim to bring the forgotten stories of NASA's equipment on the Moon and Mars to life through innovative ideas and creative storytelling.
summary:
Space Time Stories is an interactive storytelling website inspired by NASA's forgotten explorers on Mars. The project was developed to address the challenge "Abandoned But Not Forgotten" by bringing abandoned space equipment back to life through first\-person narratives.

Our website focuses on three iconic NASA explorers: Spirit Rover, Opportunity Rover, and Ingenuity Helicopter. Users can navigate through the website, view mission images, and read stories that highlight each explorer's journey, achievements, challenges, and legacy.

The project transforms technical mission information into engaging storytelling experiences, helping users connect emotionally with the equipment that contributed to important scientific discoveries. By preserving and sharing the stories of these explorers, Space Time Stories promotes awareness of space exploration, inspires curiosity, and encourages people to appreciate the lasting impact of NASA missions even after they have ended.
details:
Space Time Stories is an interactive storytelling website developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge under the challenge “Abandoned But Not Forgotten.” The project focuses on preserving the legacy of NASA equipment that remains on Mars after completing its missions.

The website features three iconic NASA explorers: Spirit Rover, Opportunity Rover, and Ingenuity Helicopter. Users can navigate through the website, view NASA-inspired images, and read first-person stories that describe each explorer’s journey, achievements, challenges, and contributions to space exploration.

The main goal of the project is to transform technical mission information into engaging storytelling experiences. Instead of presenting only facts and statistics, the website allows visitors to connect emotionally with these explorers and understand their importance in advancing scientific knowledge.

The project was developed using HTML, CSS, Visual Studio Code, Canva, and NASA mission resources. Official mission information and NASA imagery were used as inspiration for the content and visual presentation.

Our team focused on simplicity, accessibility, educational value, and user engagement. By combining storytelling with space science, Space Time Stories helps preserve the memory of NASA’s forgotten explorers and inspires curiosity about future space missions.
